question: Oda sensei, do you still read all the postcards and letters yourself? P. N. Suemitsu
answer: I read them all! And of course I will read them! And I've never dispose them over the course of 22 years (laugh). Because there're way too many of them, I can't store them in my house, so I borrowed a room, and all the letters that I've finished reading will be sent to that room. There're so much of them that one day the floor might fall off! Thank you!! Those letters contain you guys' feelings in them, so I won't throw them away.
name: Suemitsu
